Sean "sgares" Gares (formerly known as seang@res) (born June 10, 1988) is an American professional Counter-Strike 2 manager and a former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive broadcast analyst and player and a former Counter-Strike player.

sgares' playing career in Counter-Strike and Counter-Strike: Global Offensive lasted from 2007 to 2019. He is best known for his time with compLexity Gaming where he attended DreamHack Winter 2013, the first Major, and for his tenure with Cloud9 from late 2014 to mid 2015. His final notable team in Counter-Strike: Global Offensive was Misfits Gaming, after which he transitioned into broadcast work before moving to VALORANT.

In November 2025, sgares returned to the Counter-Strike scene after being appointed the Head of FPS for 100 Thieves ahead of their entry into Counter-Strike 2
